purpose: Executive-summary MODEL estimates for UNSCORED files (knowledge/26 section 5)
provenance_rule: Live inputs are OWNER-REPORTED; outputs are MODEL projections, never scores. No ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED receipt exists in this repo.

beat_champion_arithmetic.reading: Beating 0.2778 at the same 37,654-dot budget needs ~+26% more weighted credit than H29-S achieved live. A candidate whose same-instrument HOLDOUT-DTI ratio vs its H29-S anchor arm is below the required TPw ratio is MODEL-unlikely to beat 0.2778, however clean its holdout gate is.

estimates.label: MODEL (projection from stated formula; NOT a leaderboard score)
estimates.formula: central = anchor_live * (pooled buffered HOLDOUT-DTI ratio, same seeds/instrument)
estimates.candidate_holdout_label: HOLDOUT-DTI (gems27.metric v1 + holdout-blind-buffered-v2 (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, R=3px triangular, buffer_px=6.0); 120778 withheld positive occurrences)

chaining_note: H31-2 row chains two same-instrument ratios across disjoint seed sets; treat its interval as optimistic-narrow and its no-transfer bound (0.2190) as the floor.
validation_of_method: The inversion constants reproduce the focus-site autopsy (evidence/focus_sites_executive_summary_20261026.json: H29-S credit fraction 0.305). The proportional-transfer assumption itself is unvalidated on live data (only one family member, H29-S, has both a same-instrument holdout and a live score); that is why the no-transfer bound is always reported alongside the central value.
